title: Make live URL discoverable in UI and harden static asset paths

requirements.summary: Document redeploy flow and instruct how to retrieve the final live URL from the deployed site.
acceptanceCriteria: A single final live URL is produced and shared back (copy/paste ready).
Opening the final live URL in a new browser session loads the site successfully (no blank page / no generic error).

file_operations.description: Add redeploy instructions (using the repo’s existing deployment tooling) and explicitly note that the deployed site itself shows a copyable Live URL in the footer (REQ-12) to obtain the final live URL. Include brief troubleshooting for blank page/404 scenarios related to base paths and static assets.

requirements.summary: Show the current site origin in the footer with a copy-to-clipboard control and success confirmation.
acceptanceCriteria: The footer renders a label "Live URL" and displays the value derived from the browser location origin.
A "Copy" control copies the URL to clipboard and provides a simple success confirmation message (English).
The feature does not require login and works on desktop and mobile widths.

file_operations.description: Create a small footer widget that reads the current origin from the browser location, renders a “Live URL” label, and provides a copy-to-clipboard button with a simple success message. If using shadcn-ui components (e.g., Button), verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire the new LiveUrlFooter into the existing footer (no new routes). Place it in the footer layout so it is visible on desktop and mobile. If using shadcn-ui components in the footer, verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Make header/hero/footer image src paths base-path aware to prevent 404s when not hosted at domain root.
acceptanceCriteria: Header logo and hero banner images load correctly on the deployed site (no 404s).
Footer logo image loads correctly on the deployed site (no 404s).
No other site content/regressions are introduced (navigation/sections still render and smooth scroll works).

file_operations.description: Add a small helper to build base-path aware URLs for static assets using the app’s configured base URL (e.g., import.meta.env.BASE_URL) so assets under frontend/public/assets/... resolve correctly across deployments.

Replace hard-coded absolute image paths with base-aware paths for: frontend/public/assets/generated/shop-board-logo.dim_512x512.png and frontend/public/assets/generated/shop-board-banner.dim_1600x600.png (and any other referenced generated assets). Ensure header logo, hero banner, and footer logo use the helper. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
